- [Users API](https://developer.okta.com/docs/reference/api/users/) — Manage user profiles, lifecycle operations, credentials, and status changes.
- [Groups API](https://developer.okta.com/docs/reference/api/groups/) — Create and manage groups, memberships, and group-related administration.
- [Apps API](https://developer.okta.com/docs/reference/api/apps/) — Manage application integrations, assignments, and app configuration objects.
